findings.quote: Monarch Money Alternatives 2026: Plans and Prices
findings.problem: SEO title is 49 characters; page rule 5 requires 50 to 60.
findings.fix: Use e.g. 'Monarch Money Alternatives 2026: Plans and Prices Compared' (58) in title, H1 and metaTitle.

findings.quote: Who this is not for: - People who require completely offline bookkeeping ... What would change our answer: - Monarch Money altering ...
findings.problem: Both required sections render as run-in paragraphs with literal ' - ' hyphens (markdown list collapsed) inside the choose section, with no headings; 'enterprise enterprise' typo.
findings.fix: Make them H2 sections ('Who This Is Not For', 'What Would Change Our Answer') or separate paragraphs with real list markup; fix typo.

findings.quote: The table lists regular subscription rates in United States Dollars (USD) without promotional discounts.
findings.problem: False: table lists Copilot's limited-time $109 (regular $119) and Simplifi promo $3.99; Simplifi cell also mixes both.
findings.fix: Reword the note to 'Prices as published; promotional rates are labelled' or list Copilot at $119 regular with the $109 offer labelled.

findings.quote: Copilot Money ... Monthly billing is not shown. / Monthly subscription pricing is not published on the page. / Copilot Money does not display a monthly billing option
findings.problem: copilot.money/pricing has a Yearly/Monthly toggle (fetched text shows 'Yearly | Monthly'); the monthly price is not in the captured text, so 'not published' is unverified and likely false. Also drives 'What would change our answer' bullet and the YNAB page.
findings.fix: Remove all 'monthly not published/not displayed' claims; state only the verified yearly $109 (from $119, limited time) and say a monthly option is toggled on the page without a captured price, or omit.

findings.quote: At The Modern Wallet, we calculate the yearly expense of budgeting subscriptions so households can see ...
findings.problem: Self-referential 'we' process claim in the intro (unverifiable company claim, tee-up bolted on); second sentence is not the direct answer.
findings.fix: Replace with a plain fact sentence about the table or delete.

findings.quote: The service begins with a 30-day free trial ... The service connects to 14,000+ ... The company publishes ... Monarch Money utilizes general expense categorizing
findings.problem: Coy abstractions ('the service', 'the company') and inflated verb 'utilizes' on a page naming its subjects.

findings.quote: Monarch Money Core provides household sharing and partner collaboration without ads. / Monarch Money offers an active For Couples page with household sharing.
findings.problem: Household sharing is inferred from a nav item and a customer testimonial; pricing page lists no sharing in Core. The sibling YNAB page says Monarch 'does not list group sharing on its pricing page'. Contradictory.
findings.fix: Soften to what is published ('Monarch lists a For Couples page') or drop the sharing claim in both pages.

findings.quote: Quicken Simplifi at its regular $6.99 per month billed annually costs $83.88 per year (12 x $6.99)
findings.problem: Quicken's footnote says the final annual price may differ from monthly x 12; $83.88 is derived, not published. Promo $3.99 is first-year, new members only, ends Dec 8, 2026, not stated.
findings.fix: Label $83.88 as 'about' or drop; add that the $3.99 offer is first-year, new-member only.

findings.quote: Copilot Money falls short of Monarch Money on cross-platform accessibility
findings.problem: Copilot lists iPhone, iPad, Mac and Web; claim of cross-platform shortfall is not supported by its site.
findings.fix: Delete or restate as 'lists iPhone, iPad, Mac and Web; no Android app listed'.

findings.problem: Evidence tag is generic, not the [PAA n/m; ac n/m] format; no tee-up/anchor record.
findings.fix: Record proper evidence tag in prompt/row records.
